changelog:
• Double-tap seek gestures: double-tap left half to rewind 10s, right half to fast-forward 10s with YouTube-style animated HUD overlays
• Clean minimalist controls: automatically hides +10/-10 buttons when gestures are enabled, leaving a clean center Play/Pause toggle
• Fixed Player Settings rotation layout: shortened to 'Auto' to prevent overflow and wrapping
• Smart link validation: automatically checks if the existing video stream is active before regenerating from Facebook
